items.quote: Toledo Construction does a great job. They're very thorough and pay great attention to details. The owner is great at communicating with customers and from our experience, takes great pride in his work. They did roofing for us and remodeled …

Armando is the best contractor I ever worked with. He went above and beyond, and truly helped us more than anyone I've ever worked with in the space. If you need a general contractor in Miami, he is the guy!

I hired Toledo Construction for a kitchen remodel. From the first day, they were professional over the phone and face to face. I'm happy with the way my kitchen turned out and the turn around time for the project, which is why I'm writing this review. I highly recommend them for any project and would use them again.
